paper_metadata.title: Effect of Nb content on the mechanical properties of Nbx(MoTaW)(1-x) (x = 0.4, 0.55, and 0.7) refractory multicomponent alloys

evidence.quote: The MoNbTaW refractory multicomponent alloy (RMCA) retains good yield strength up to 1873K

a series of alloys with varying Nb content, namely Nb x (MoTaW) (1-x) with x = 0.4, 0.55, and 0.7 (designated as Nb 0.4 , Nb 0.55, and Nb 0.7 in this manuscript), were processed using vacuum arc melting

annealed at 1673 K for 24 h in vacuum
